text: Semantic Segmentation is a group of pixels that acts as a reference point for object detection and produces a mesh-like map for that object. These pixels are grouped by drawing them over images by data annotators.
How to Draw in Semantic Segmentation.
Step 1: Select the polygon tool for drawing.
Step 2: click along the edges of the person.
Step 3: continue to click along the edges of the person.
Step 4: press ‘enter’ when the annotation is complete.
Step 5: click on the class dropdown button
Delete a semantic point or remove current point.
Press  backspace on the key to remove the current point

Expand the image or reduce the image(Zoom)
Use these buttons to increase the size of the image or reduce it. This helps to see the object boundaries clearly.

Front mode : if there is an existing shape, draw on top of that shape.
Rear mode : if there is an existing shape, draw behind that existing shape
Note : if there is no shape drawn in that region then your mode can either be in front mode or rear mode.
Note:  you can leave it rear mode, so that every shape can just fall behind the other.
These modes apply to all the main tools. You can only use one at a time. You are either drawing on top of another object, or you are drawing behind another object.
